tasks.title: Compose Hono app and bootstrap server with /api/health and JWT_SECRET fast-fail
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/app.ts and apps/api/src/main.ts. app.ts: build a Hono app instance, install middleware in order (requestId, logger, csrf, authn-for-protected-paths, errorHandler via app.onError), register `GET /api/health` returning `{ ok: true }` un-authenticated, mount `authRoutes` under `/api`; export `createApp({ deps })` and a default `app` bound to live deps. main.ts: imports `config` (which throws on bad JWT_SECRET at module load — DO NOT swallow the throw), constructs the live app via createApp, serves it via `serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port })` from `@hono/node-server`, logs `{ event: 'server.start', port }`. main.ts must be importable for the bootstrap test without binding to a port — refactor so the import side only does config-validation + app-construction, and the listen is a separate `startServer()` call invoked at the bottom guarded by a top-level await or `if (import.meta.url === ...)`-style check (so the test can import without listening).

tasks.title: Implement HTTP middleware: requestId, logger, csrf, authn (jose), authz, errorHandler
tasks.description: Create the six middleware modules wired in the order specified by ARCHITECTURE.md §1: requestId → logger → cors (defer to a later sprint; export a no-op placeholder if absent) → csrf → authn → authz, with errorHandler installed at the app level. (1) requestId.ts: generates uuid v4, sets `c.set('requestId', ...)`, adds `X-Request-Id` response header. (2) logger.ts: emits one structured log line per request `{ requestId, method, path, status, durationMs, userId? }`; attaches the child logger to `c.set('log', child)`. (3) csrf.ts: enforces double-submit only on state-changing methods (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE); compares `csrf_token` cookie value against `X-CSRF-Token` header with a constant-time comparison (`crypto.timingSafeEqual` after length check); on mismatch throws `ForbiddenError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN' })`. Login/refresh paths get an exemption hook (so first-login can issue the cookie). (4) authn.ts: reads the `session` cookie, verifies the JWT via `jose.jwtVerify` with HS256 + JWT_SECRET; on success attaches `{ userId, role, email }` to `c.set('user', ...)`; on missing/invalid throws `UnauthorizedError`. Exposes a `requireAuth` middleware variant for routes that must be authenticated and an `optionalAuth` variant for `auth.me`-style probes (decide at this task: requireAuth throws 401; auth.me uses requireAuth). (5) authz.ts: `requireRole('patient' | 'doctor' | ...)` factory that reads `c.get('user').role` and throws ForbiddenError if it does not match. (6) errorHandler.ts: registered via `app.onError`; if the thrown value is an AppError, render `{ error: { code, message?, details? } }` with the correct status; otherwise log at level=error and return 500 with `{ error: { code: 'INTERNAL' } }`. All middleware must NEVER log the JWT, refresh token, CSRF token value, or password.

tasks.title: Scaffold apps/api package: package.json, tsconfig, vitest projects, drizzle.config
tasks.description: Stand up the Hono API workspace. Create apps/api/package.json (name `@medbridge/api`, type `module`, scripts: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), build (tsc -p tsconfig.json), start (node dist/main.js), dev (tsx watch src/main.ts), test (vitest run), test:integration (vitest run --project integration), migrate (drizzle-kit migrate), generate (drizzle-kit generate), seed (node dist/seed/main.js); deps: hono ^4.6, @hono/node-server ^1.13, drizzle-orm ^0.38, pg ^8.13, argon2 ^0.41, jose ^5.9, pino ^9.5, zod ^4 (peer via workspace), @medbridge/contracts workspace:*; devDeps: typescript ^5.7, tsx ^4.19, vitest ^2.1, @vitest/coverage-v8 ^2.1, drizzle-kit ^0.30, @testcontainers/postgresql ^10.13, @types/pg, @types/node). Create apps/api/tsconfig.json extending tsconfig.base.json (rootDir src, outDir dist, types: ['node']). Create apps/api/vitest.config.ts using Vitest v3 projects API: `unit` (include src/**/*.test.ts, default pool, environment node, globals false, clearMocks true) and `integration` (include test/integration/**/*.test.ts, pool: 'forks' with singleFork: true, testTimeout: 90000). Create apps/api/drizzle.config.ts pointing at `src/db/schema.ts` and `src/db/migrations/`, dialect 'postgresql', dbCredentials reading DATABASE_URL.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1, §4.2-§4.3 (drizzle schema barrel and migrations location)

tasks.title: Implement apps/api shared infra: AppError taxonomy, pino logger, drizzle client, config, ids, time
tasks.description: Create the cross-cutting shared modules every feature inherits. (1) shared/errors.ts: an `AppError` base class plus `ValidationError(422)`, `UnauthorizedError(401)`, `ForbiddenError(403)`, `NotFoundError(404)`, `ConflictError(409)`, `UnsupportedMediaError(415)`, `PayloadTooLargeError(413)`, `TooManyRequestsError(429)` — each carries a `code` (e.g. `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`), an HTTP `status`, optional `message`, optional `details`. (2) shared/logger.ts: pino root logger with redact paths covering `req.headers.cookie`, `req.headers.authorization`, `req.body.password`, `res.headers.set-cookie`, `*.password`, `*.token`, `*.token_hash`, `*.refresh_token`, `*.csrf_token`, `*.jwt` (redact value, not key); a `childLogger(requestId, userId?)` factory for request-scoped logging. (3) shared/db.ts: drizzle `db` singleton built from `pg.Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL })`, plus a `transaction<T>(fn)` re-export. (4) shared/config.ts: loads env at module init; exports `config` with `JWT_SECRET` (throws on missing or <32 bytes), `SESSION_TTL_MS = 15*60*1000`, `REFRESH_TTL_MS = 7*24*60*60*1000`, `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`, `RATE_LIMIT_MAX = 5`, `LOG_LEVEL`, `NODE_ENV`, `DATABASE_URL`, `SEED_PASSWORD`. The JWT_SECRET assertion must throw an Error with a clear message; do NOT lazily validate — validate at config-module load time so the bootstrap test can observe the thrown error. (5) shared/ids.ts: `newRequestId()` (uuid v4 via node:crypto), branded UserId type re-exported from contracts. (6) shared/time.ts: `now()` returning Date plus `addMs(date, ms)`; encapsulates Date.now so unit tests can inject a clock.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.2 (AppError taxonomy), §5.3 (logger + redaction rule), §4.1 (single pg pool)

tasks.title: Implement argon2id password hash/verify utility with injectable verify dependency
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/password.ts. Export `hashPassword(plain: string): Promise<string>` (argon2id with OWASP 2024 defaults `m=19456 KiB, t=2, p=1` per TECH_STACK §4.1) and `verifyPassword(hash: string, plain: string): Promise<boolean>`. CRITICAL: also export a `createPasswordVerifier({ verify }: { verify: typeof argon2.verify })` factory that returns a verify function — this is the injection seam the security test uses to spy on argon2.verify and confirm it is invoked exactly once even when the email is unknown (constant-time path). The auth service must consume this factory and pass the live argon2.verify in production; the integration test replaces verify with a vi.fn wrapping the real implementation and asserts call count. Add a colocated unit test apps/api/src/modules/auth/password.test.ts that round-trips hash → verify and asserts an unrelated plaintext fails verify.

tasks.title: Implement in-memory sliding-window login rate limiter (5 attempts / 15 min per IP+email)
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/rateLimit.ts exporting a `LoginRateLimiter` class (or factory) keyed by `${ip}:${email.toLowerCase()}`. Use a single Map with bounded growth (sweep expired keys lazily on hit). API: `tryAcquire(ip: string, email: string): { allowed: boolean; retryAfterSeconds?: number }`. Window: 15 minutes (config.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS), max: 5 attempts (config.RATE_LIMIT_MAX). Successful login does NOT reset the counter — only window expiry does (per bullet 12). Inject a clock function `now: () => number` so unit tests can advance virtual time. Add a colocated unit test apps/api/src/modules/auth/rateLimit.test.ts: 5 sequential calls allowed, 6th denied with retryAfterSeconds > 0, then advance clock past the window and assert allowed again.
context: .planning/features/api-scaffold-auth.enriched.md (bullet 12: in-memory sliding window, no Redis, no DB)

tasks.title: Integration tests for refresh rotation: happy rotation, replay 401, concurrent race, family theft revoke
tasks.description: Create apps/api/test/integration/auth.refresh.test.ts. Scenarios: (1) Happy rotation: log in to obtain refresh cookie, POST /api/auth.refresh, assert 200, assert the OLD refresh_token row has non-null revoked_at and a non-null replaced_by_id pointing at the NEW row, the NEW row has the same family_id, the response sets fresh session+refresh+csrf cookies. (2) Replay (theft): log in, refresh once (rotating), then POST /api/auth.refresh AGAIN with the FIRST (now-revoked) refresh cookie — assert (a) response is 401 with `{ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } }`, (b) every refresh_token row sharing that family_id has non-null revoked_at, (c) the captured logger emits exactly ONE `level=warn` line whose body contains the seeded userId, the familyId, and a requestId (use logCapture buffer). (3) Concurrent: log in, then issue two POST /api/auth.refresh calls in parallel via `Promise.all` against the SAME refresh cookie — assert exactly one returns 200 with new cookies and exactly one returns 401 (the loser hits the revoked row inside the FOR UPDATE). The test must not rely on timing; it relies on the FOR UPDATE semantics of the implementation. (4) Expired token: insert a refresh_token row whose expires_at is in the past, attempt refresh, assert 401.

tasks.title: Implement auth repo: user lookup, refresh_token CRUD with FOR UPDATE and family revoke
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/repo.ts as the only file in the module touching the Drizzle client. Functions (all accept an optional tx argument that defaults to the singleton db): `findUserByEmail(email)`, `findUserById(id)`, `insertRefreshToken({ userId, tokenHash, familyId, expiresAt }, tx)`, `findActiveRefreshTokenForUpdate(tokenHash, tx)` which executes `SELECT ... FROM refresh_token WHERE token_hash = $1 FOR UPDATE` inside the caller's transaction and returns the row (including `revoked_at` so the service can detect the already-revoked case), `markRefreshTokenRotated({ id, newTokenId }, tx)` which sets `revoked_at = now(), replaced_by_id = $newTokenId` on the old row, `revokeRefreshTokenById(id, tx)` for logout, `revokeRefreshTokenFamily(familyId, tx)` which UPDATEs every row whose family_id matches and revoked_at IS NULL to set revoked_at = now(). All inserts/updates use Drizzle's typed query builder; FOR UPDATE is appended via `.for('update')` (drizzle 0.38 syntax) or a raw fragment if the helper is absent.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 (repo is the only file touching db client; service calls repo)
.planning/features/api-scaffold-auth.enriched.md (bullets 4, 10, 11: rotation tx + FOR UPDATE + family revoke)

tasks.title: Wire Hono routes: auth.login, auth.logout, auth.refresh, auth.me with Zod parse and cookie I/O
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/routes.ts exporting a Hono `authRoutes` router. Endpoints: `POST /api/auth.login` — parses body via `loginRequest`; calls `service.login({ ip: c.req.header('x-forwarded-for') ?? c.req.raw.headers.get('host') ?? 'local', ... })`; sets cookies on success: `session` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path=/api, Max-Age=SESSION_TTL_MS/1000), `refresh_token` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path=/api/auth.refresh, Max-Age=REFRESH_TTL_MS/1000), `csrf_token` (NON-HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path=/, Max-Age=SESSION_TTL_MS/1000); returns 200 with `loginResponse`; on 429 also sets `Retry-After` header. `POST /api/auth.logout` — exempt from CSRF (idempotent state-clear) OR enforce CSRF only when a session cookie is present (decide: enforce CSRF when session present, skip otherwise to keep idempotent); calls `service.logout` with the refresh cookie if present; always clears the three cookies (Set-Cookie with Max-Age=0); returns 204. `POST /api/auth.refresh` — exempt from CSRF (the refresh cookie + same-origin already gate this), reads `refresh_token` cookie, calls `service.refresh`, sets new cookies (rotation), returns 200 with `refreshResponse`. `GET /api/auth.me` — requires authn middleware, returns 200 with `meResponse`. All responses validated via the contracts schemas before send (safeParse with throw on bad shape — defensive).
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 (routes parse + call service), §5.4 (cookie shape), §6.1 (RPC naming `<resource>.<verb>`)

tasks.title: Integration tests for auth.login, auth.logout (idempotent), and auth.me happy + sad paths
tasks.description: Create three integration test files under apps/api/test/integration/. (1) auth.login.test.ts: seeds one user via fixtures; asserts (a) POST /api/auth.login with the correct password returns 200, sets all three cookies with the right flags (HttpOnly+Secure on session and refresh_token, NON-HttpOnly on csrf_token), and returns `{ user: { id, email, role } }` matching the seeded user; (b) wrong password returns 401 with `{ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } }` and NO Set-Cookie headers; (c) malformed body (missing email) returns 422. (2) auth.logout.test.ts: asserts (a) POST /api/auth.logout with NO cookies returns 204, sets all three cookies with Max-Age=0 (cleared), and inserts ZERO rows / updates ZERO rows (assert by counting refresh_token rows before/after); (b) POST /api/auth.logout with a fresh refresh cookie returns 204 AND flips that row's `revoked_at` from null to a timestamp. (3) auth.me.test.ts: asserts (a) GET /api/auth.me with a valid session cookie returns 200 with `{ user: { id, email, role } }` matching the cookie; (b) GET /api/auth.me with no cookie returns 401 with the UNAUTHORIZED envelope; (c) GET /api/auth.me with a tampered JWT returns 401. Each test file boots its own Postgres container in beforeAll, applies migrations, truncates between describes.

tasks.title: Define Drizzle schemas for user and refresh_token tables
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/schema.ts with two Drizzle pgTable definitions. `user`: `id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()`, `email citext unique not null`, `role text not null` with a check constraint `role in ('patient','doctor')`, `created_at timestamptz not null default now()`, `deleted_at timestamptz null`, plus a `password_hash text not null` column (argon2id digest). Note: citext is a Postgres type — declare it via `customType` (Drizzle does not ship a citext helper). `refresh_token`: `id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid()`, `user_id uuid not null` FK → `user(id)` with onDelete: 'restrict', `token_hash text not null unique` (sha256 hex of the raw cookie value), `family_id uuid not null`, `replaced_by_id uuid null` self-FK with onDelete: 'restrict', `expires_at timestamptz not null`, `revoked_at timestamptz null`, `created_at timestamptz not null default now()`. Export both tables and their inferred row types (`type UserRow = typeof user.$inferSelect; type NewUser = typeof user.$inferInsert;` etc.).
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2 (schema split by module), §4.4 (timestamptz + soft-delete + ON DELETE RESTRICT)

tasks.title: Security integration tests: CSRF 403, log scrub, rate-limit 429, constant-time argon2 verify
tasks.description: Create apps/api/test/integration/auth.security.test.ts. Four scenarios. (1) CSRF — log in to obtain cookies, then POST /api/auth.logout with the session cookie BUT missing X-CSRF-Token header (or mismatched value), assert 403 with `{ error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN' } }`. Repeat against a state-changing route that requires CSRF; assert the matched-header path succeeds (proving the check is value-comparison not presence-only). (2) Log scrub — install the logCapture destination as the pino destination for this test's app, exercise login (happy + 401) and refresh (happy + replay) and logout flows, then assert NO captured log line contains: the plaintext password, the JWT string, the refresh raw token string, the CSRF token value — use `JSON.stringify(line).includes(secret)` checks across every captured line. (3) Rate-limit — for the SAME email + simulated IP (`X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.1`), fire 6 sequential POST /api/auth.login with WRONG password; assert attempts 1-5 return 401 and attempt 6 returns 429 with `{ error: { code: 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS' } }` and a `Retry-After` header > 0. As a second assertion, prove that a SUCCESSFUL login does NOT reset the counter: after the 429, an attempt with the CORRECT password from the same IP+email still returns 429. (4) Constant-time argon2 verify — wire the service's password verifier as a `vi.fn(async (...args) => realVerify(...args))` spy, fire POST /api/auth.login (a) with an UNKNOWN email and (b) with a known email + wrong password, assert in BOTH cases the spy was called exactly ONCE (proving the unknown-email path still incurs argon2id work).

tasks.title: Implement auth service: login, logout (idempotent), refresh (rotation+theft), me, plus module index
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts and apps/api/src/modules/auth/index.ts (public surface). Functions: (1) `login({ email, password, ip, clientLogger })` — calls `rateLimiter.tryAcquire(ip, email)`, throws `TooManyRequestsError` with the retry-after seconds on exhaustion; calls `findUserByEmail` and ALWAYS calls `passwordVerifier.verify(storedHash || fakeHash, password)` (use a precomputed constant fake hash when the user is not found so timing leaks no signal — verify is invoked exactly once in both paths); on mismatch throws `UnauthorizedError({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' })`; on match issues access JWT (jose, HS256, exp = now + SESSION_TTL_MS, claims { sub: userId, role, email }), a refresh raw token (32-byte crypto.randomBytes, hex), inserts refresh_token row with new familyId, generates a csrf_token (32-byte hex), and returns `{ user, sessionCookie, refreshCookie, csrfCookie }` — the route layer attaches Set-Cookie. (2) `logout({ refreshTokenRaw? })` — fully idempotent: if a refresh raw token is presented, hash it (sha256), open tx, FOR UPDATE the row, if found and not revoked set revoked_at = now(); commit. Always returns void (route returns 204). Never throws on missing/invalid cookie. (3) `refresh({ refreshTokenRaw, ip, clientLogger })` — opens a single tx, calls `findActiveRefreshTokenForUpdate(hash)`. If row missing → throw UnauthorizedError. If row.revoked_at is non-null (replay / theft) → call `revokeRefreshTokenFamily(row.family_id)`, emit one log line `clientLogger.warn({ userId, familyId, requestId }, 'refresh token replay detected')`, commit, throw UnauthorizedError. If row.expires_at <= now() → throw UnauthorizedError. Otherwise insert a NEW refresh_token row with same family_id, call `markRefreshTokenRotated({ id: row.id, newTokenId })`, mint new session JWT + new csrf_token, return new cookies. (4) `me({ userId })` — `findUserById` and return `{ user: { id, email, role } }`; throw UnauthorizedError on not found / soft-deleted. The service module accepts dependencies via a constructor / factory `createAuthService({ repo, passwordVerifier, jwtSigner, rateLimiter, clock, idGen })` so integration tests can inject the spied verify. Module index.ts exports ONLY `createAuthService`, the service type, and a default service instance bound to live deps — nothing else.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 (service layer can call other modules' index.ts; repo-only db touch), §5.2 (AppError), §5.4 (JWT + CSRF double-submit)

tasks.title: Bootstrap + seed integration tests: JWT_SECRET fast-fail and seed idempotency
tasks.description: Two test files. (1) apps/api/test/integration/bootstrap.test.ts — uses Vitest's `vi.stubEnv('JWT_SECRET', 'short')` (or removes it entirely) before dynamic-import of the config / app module; asserts the import throws an Error whose message references JWT_SECRET and the 32-byte requirement. Also asserts that with a valid 32+ byte secret the import succeeds and the resulting app can answer `GET /api/health` with 200. (2) apps/api/test/integration/seed.idempotency.test.ts — boots a Postgres container, applies migrations, runs the seed (invoke `apps/api/src/seed/main.ts`'s exported `runSeed()` function — refactor seed/main.ts to expose `runSeed({ db })` if needed, with the file's top-level invocation guarded by an `import.meta.main` check), assert exactly 2 user rows (one doctor, one patient) and that both have non-null password_hash; run the seed AGAIN, assert exit code 0 (no throw) and STILL exactly 2 user rows (zero inserts). Also assert both seeded users authenticate via POST /api/auth.login with the seed password.

tasks.title: Add auth Zod request/response schemas to packages/contracts
tasks.description: Create packages/contracts/src/auth.ts exporting Zod v4 schemas for the four auth RPC operations: `loginRequest` ({ email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(1) }), `loginResponse` ({ user: { id: brandedUserId, email, role: z.enum(['patient','doctor']) } }), `logoutResponse` (z.object({}).strict() or z.void() — choose void since the route returns 204), `refreshResponse` ({ user: { id, email, role } }), `meResponse` ({ user: { id, email, role } }), and `errorEnvelope` ({ error: { code: z.enum(['UNAUTHORIZED','FORBIDDEN','TOO_MANY_REQUESTS','VALIDATION','INTERNAL']), message: z.string().optional(), details: z.unknown().optional() } }). Export the inferred TS types via `z.infer`. Re-export from packages/contracts/src/index.ts via `export * from './auth.js'`. The branded UserId helper lives here (`z.string().uuid().brand<'UserId'>()`).

Create packages/contracts/package.json (name `@medbridge/contracts`, type `module`, scripts: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), build (tsc -p tsconfig.json), test (vitest run), zod ^4 + dev deps typescript/vitest); packages/contracts/tsconfig.json extending tsconfig.base.json with composite + declaration outDir dist; packages/contracts/vitest.config.ts with passWithNoTests: true and include `src/**/*.test.ts`; packages/contracts/src/index.ts as an empty barrel comment `// re-exports added by feature tasks`. tasks.title: Author docker-compose.yml, apps/api Dockerfile, .dockerignore for postgres + api-migrate + api
tasks.description: Compose v2 single-host stack. docker-compose.yml services: (1) `postgres` (image postgres:17-alpine, env POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB, named volume `pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data`, healthcheck `pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER}` interval 5s retries 20). (2) `api-migrate` (build apps/api Dockerfile target `migrate`, depends_on postgres: condition: service_healthy, command `sh -lc 'pnpm --filter @medbridge/api migrate && node dist/seed/main.js'`, restart `no`, env DATABASE_URL + SEED_PASSWORD + NODE_ENV=production). (3) `api` (same image, target `api`, depends_on api-migrate: condition: service_completed_successfully, command `node dist/main.js`, healthcheck `wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1` interval 5s retries 20, ports `3000:3000`, env DATABASE_URL + JWT_SECRET + LOG_LEVEL). apps/api/Dockerfile: multi-stage. Stage `base` (node:25-alpine, corepack enable, pnpm 10), `deps` (copies pnpm-workspace.yaml + root package.json + workspaces' package.jsons, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`), `build` (copies src, `pnpm -r build`), `migrate` (carries dist + drizzle-kit + migrations, CMD migrate-then-seed), `api` (carries dist, CMD `node dist/main.js`). .dockerignore: node_modules, dist, .env, .git. Update .env.example only if any new var (JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, SEED_PASSWORD already present from task-workspace-root).

tasks.title: Generate initial Drizzle migration with pgcrypto, citext, user, and refresh_token tables
tasks.description: Produce the initial committed SQL migration. Run `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api generate -- --name init` and then hand-edit the resulting `0000_init.sql` so it starts with `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;` and `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext;` (Drizzle Kit will not emit these from the schema). Verify the generated SQL contains both tables with the exact columns from the schema, the unique constraint on `refresh_token.token_hash`, the check constraint on `user.role`, the FK from `refresh_token.user_id` ON DELETE RESTRICT, and the self-FK from `refresh_token.replaced_by_id` ON DELETE RESTRICT. Commit the meta files `meta/_journal.json` and `meta/0000_snapshot.json`. The migration is forward-only — no down migration. The file path under apps/api/src/db/migrations/ is the canonical location that the `api-migrate` one-shot container will apply.

custom.cmd: rg --quiet -i 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto' apps/api/src/db/migrations/0000_init.sql
rg --quiet -i 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext' apps/api/src/db/migrations/0000_init.sql

tasks.title: Implement idempotent seed creating one patient and one doctor with hashed shared password
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/seed/main.ts. Behavior: reads SEED_PASSWORD from env (default `medbridge-dev` only when NODE_ENV=development/test); for each of `doctor1@medbridge.local` (role=doctor) and `patient1@medbridge.local` (role=patient): query `user` by email; if row exists, log `{ event: 'seed.user.skip', email, role }` at level=info and continue; otherwise hash SEED_PASSWORD via the auth password util (single hash computed once, reused for all users — costs ~50ms argon2id), insert the row, log `{ event: 'seed.user.insert', email, role }`. Exit 0 on success. Re-running on a populated DB inserts zero rows and exits 0 (idempotent). Connects to DATABASE_URL via the same shared db client and runs migrations are NOT a concern of this script — the api-migrate container does `drizzle-kit migrate && node dist/seed/main.js`, so by the time this runs the schema is up. Add a clean shutdown (`pool.end()`) so the container exits.

tasks.title: Terminal smoke: full workspace install, typecheck, build, test, lint

Verifies the entire repo from a clean install: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (the lockfile must exist by now), `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm -r test`, and `pnpm biome check .`. No files created — this is purely a verification gate. Builder runs zero edits.

tasks.title: Build integration-test support: testcontainers Postgres, request helper, fixtures, log capture
tasks.description: Create the reusable support layer under apps/api/test/support/ (NEVER named `*.test.ts`). (1) db.ts: exports `startPostgres()` (returns a `StartedPostgreSqlContainer` + connection string), `applyMigrations(connectionString)` (calls drizzle-kit migrate against the container — use drizzle-orm's `migrate(db, { migrationsFolder })` programmatic API, not the CLI), and `truncateAllTables(db)` (uses `TRUNCATE user, refresh_token RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE` — only the tables created so far). (2) fixtures.ts: typed factories `insertUser({ email, role, password? })` that hashes once via the auth password util and returns the row, plus `insertSeededDoctor` / `insertSeededPatient` returning the inserted row. (3) request.ts: a thin supertest-like wrapper around `app.fetch` (Hono is Fetch API-native): `request(app).post('/api/auth.login').json({...}).headers({...}).cookies({...}).send()` returning a Response-like object with `.status`, `.json()`, `.cookies()` (parsed Set-Cookie array with name/value/HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite/Max-Age/Path), `.header(name)`. (4) assertions.ts: helpers like `expectErrorEnvelope(res, { code })`, `expectCookieSet(cookies, name, opts)`, `expectCookieCleared(cookies, name)`. (5) passwords.ts: a `seededPassword()` that returns a single cached argon2id hash + plain pair so tests don't pay the ~50ms hash cost per insert. (6) logCapture.ts: a pino destination stream that buffers JSON lines into a returned `LogBuffer` with `lines()`, `findOne(predicate)`, `findMany(predicate)` — used to assert presence/absence of fields in emitted log lines.
context: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §8 Q7 (testcontainers per file, single fork)

tasks.title: Bootstrap pnpm workspace root: package.json, tsconfig.base, biome, .env.example, .gitignore
tasks.description: Create the root files that anchor the pnpm workspace: a root package.json declaring packageManager pnpm@10, engines node >=25, and root scripts (typecheck/build/test/lint that fan out via `pnpm -r`); a tsconfig.base.json with strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess + exactOptionalPropertyTypes; biome.json with recommended + correctness/noUnusedImports + style/useImportType + suspicious/noExplicitAny: error; a .npmrc that pins corepack-friendly defaults; a .gitignore covering node_modules, dist, .env, coverage, drizzle metadata; and a .env.example documenting JWT_SECRET, SEED_PASSWORD (with the `# dev only — never reuse in any non-local environment` comment), DATABASE_URL, UPLOAD_DIR, LOG_LEVEL, NODE_ENV. Update pnpm-workspace.yaml only if its current shape is not exactly `packages: [apps/*, packages/*]`. Do NOT create apps/* or packages/* contents here — they land in dedicated tasks.

lint: pnpm biome check biome.json package.json tsconfig.base.json
